notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only, fully successful - robots.txt (User-agent: * / Allow: /) permits fetch tools, no blocks encountered. Used requests with a browser UA. TREE: Built via (1) full mega-menu extracted from homepage HTML with BeautifulSoup, capturing all 6 top-level tabs (Lighting & Lamps, Furniture, Decor, Home Fragrances, Kitchenware, Utility) and every heading + nested child link, and (2) collections.json (paginated, 952 total collections site-wide) cross-referenced to confirm handles/titles and to spot brand/style/promotional collections (Best Selling X, Selective Edition, Designer Collection, room-style collections like 'bohemian-bedroom', brand-name collections) which were excluded as non-tree promotional/collection pages per rule 27/35. Site is a multi-brand home decor marketplace (Ikiru), so the 952-collection sitemap is dominated by such non-tree pages; only genuine mega-menu nodes were used for the tree. QTY: exact unique-product-id count via paginated /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, looped until an empty page), which was spot-verified against the theme's rendered 'N products' text and canonical URL for 6 handles (rugs-and-carpets=115, decorative-storage-boxes=76, bathroom-cabinet-and-shelves=7, trunk=4, key-holder=5, hooks=1) - all matched exactly, so the method was trusted for the rest. coat-stand qty=0 confirmed via the page's own 'Sorry, there are no products in this collection.' message (200 OK, live page). EXCLUDED (Furniture tab placement, storage.md rule 21/27 - site explicitly files under Furniture, not Storage): TV Unit, the whole 'Storage Shelves & Racks' furniture-column head plus its children Wall Shelves, Bookshelf, Shoe Rack, Trolley (generic), Wardrobe, Chest of Drawers, Cabinets & Sideboard - all Furniture task territory despite storage-sounding names. EXCLUDED (checked product samples, primary purpose not storage/textile): Kitchen Trolley (16 products, all bar/serving carts - storage.md rule 20 excludes serving carts), Office Desk Accessories (63 products, majority bookends/decor clock - not primarily storage), Waste Bin, Bookends, Cloth Drying Stand (utility/drying appliance, not storage per rule 11), Masala Box/Roti Box & Casserole/Dish Drainer/Chopping Board/Lunch Box/Mortar & Pestle/Oil Dispenser/Tea/Other Kitchen Utility (Kitchen & Dining, storage.md rule 13 boundary), Coasters/Tissue Holder/Cutlery Stand/Napkin Rings (Kitchen & Dining tableware, not fabric), Bathroom Accessories group (Dispensers, Soap Dish, Toilet Paper Holder, Towel Holder Stand - bathroom hardware/fixtures, textile.md rule 9 and storage.md rule 28 exclude holders/dispensers), all Pooja/religious/decor-object/wall-decor/mirror/vase/planter/clock nodes (Decorative Home Accessories/Wall Decor task territory), all Lighting nodes, all remaining Furniture nodes (Sofas, Tables, Beds, Chairs, Bar Furniture, Seating, Dining sets, Outdoor Furniture). LOW/MEDIUM confidence rows are flagged individually where product-sample spot-checks showed mixed/noisy content (common on this multi-brand marketplace where a handful of unrelated SKUs bleed into a category) or where the node is a genuine judgment call (Key Holder, Hooks, Trunk, Kitchen Storage Shelf & Rack's dual Furniture/Kitchenware nav placement).
